mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing partly cloudy skies and a comfortable 84 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park.
The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous vote, setting a long-term roadmap for sustainable growth, housing, and downtown development.
We have several community activities coming up, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by various trivia events tomorrow at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and more.
On September 28, the Verona Police Department responded to a two-vehicle crash on CTH-PB at CTH-M, resulting in a citation for failure to keep a vehicle under control.
You can enjoy today's flavor of the day, Chocolate Heath Crunch, at Culver's, which remains open for business until 11 PM tonight.
